prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 photograph of a handmade stop-motion miniature set: a tiny British corner shop built from cardboard, felt and plasticine, with visible thumbprints in the clay and fraying felt edges. A loaf of plain white bread the size of a fingertip sits on the counter with a little paper price flag reading "£5"; a crossed-out paper flag reading "£1" lies on the floor. An unbranded small purple chocolate bar with a plain wrapper sits beside it, flagged "£2". Lit by a single miniature filament bulb, so the set falls into shadow fast; the painted backdrop of the shop's rear wall is darker than it should be, and the shelving's shadow leans toward the loaf. Macro lens, shallow depth of field, practical-effects charm turned uneasy. Thanks.
